blind.description: A stylized wooden scroll rack/cabinet featuring a 4x3 grid of twelve cubby holes tightly packed with rolled parchment scrolls, several tied with maroon ribbons. The flat wooden top supports two individual rolled scrolls with ribbon ties. The back is enclosed with wood paneling, and the piece rests solidly on four short corner block feet.
blind.from_above: A flat rectangular brown wooden top holding two horizontal rolled scrolls tied with maroon ribbons, with a cast rectangular shadow extending onto the ground.
blind.height_vs_figure: About half the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure (roughly 3 feet tall) and about 2.5 to 3 feet wide.
